You are a Python 3.12 engineer extending an offline-first probe harness for freytag-forge, approved by Brandon. Working directory: /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge (branch 1a-opening-and-truck-feedback). Environment: no uv. Run `export PYTHONPATH=/home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge TMPDIR=/tmp CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL=https://w.example` then `.venv/bin/python`. NEVER make a real network call or a billed call: every test and your own checks must stub the network. Do not git commit.

YOU MAY CREATE OR EDIT ONLY: scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe4.py and tests/test_opening_truck_probe4.py (both new). Never edit storygame/, packages/, data/, docs/, bench/, .plans/, or any existing script or test. The preregistration you implement is .plans/1a-opening-and-truck-feedback/probe4-prereg.md: read it first. Read scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe3.py and probe2.py and probe.py fully and reuse their helpers and CLI shape (probe3._insert_player_action, _new_product_replay style, _canonical_hash, _diff, _offline_worker_environment, _record, _quota_row, _validate_live_guard, boarding_probe CallCounter, QuotaExceeded, CallCapExceeded, _send_narrator, _write_json).

IMPORTANT: the shipped code now REMOVES the raw movement phrase from the boarding-turn narrator request and ADDS a SCENE bullet 'Kristin can reach anything inside Kristin's truck from the driver's seat.', so probe2._control_request (which looks for the raw '- <command>' line) will fail on the current code. Write your own capture: a product-wired replay (WorldCapture attached, boarding scripted yes for a command naming the truck, network stubbed, narrator forced to be called on the boarding turn exactly as probe2._new_product_replay does), route 'open the drawer','feel in the gap', then the command, and keep the narrator request on the boarding turn, identified as the captured request whose user text contains 'Already done:'.

BUILD scripts/ringer/opening_truck/probe4.py, CLI `(--dry | --smoke | --run) --out PATH [--max-calls N] [--confirm]`, default max-calls 48, narrator calls only.
1. build_document(), offline: for each command in ('head out to the truck', 'go to the truck'): arm A = the captured boarding-turn request as built; assert its user text contains the line `- Kristin can reach anything inside Kristin's truck from the driver's seat.`, contains `- Already done:`, contains the line `- Kristin. Place: driver's seat.`, and has NO line equal to `- <command>`. Arm B = arm A plus the PLAYER line `- Kristin takes in what she can see and reach from the driver's seat.` inserted between the place line and the Already done line (probe3._insert_player_action); assert the diff against arm A is exactly that one added line. Record both diffs, the requests, and a document hash.
2. Plan: 10 samples per arm per command, interleaved round-robin over (command, arm): 40 calls. Cap check before the first call rejects a planned total above --max-calls (--max-calls 39 is refused). Variant labels 'A' and 'B'; rows carry command, variant, sample, system, user and the narrator reply fields.
3. --dry writes the document and makes zero calls (print 'dry: document built, 40 planned calls, 0 calls'). --smoke (billed, needs --confirm) is exactly 2 calls: arm A 'head out to the truck' sample 1 and arm B 'go to the truck' sample 1. --run (billed, needs --confirm) is all 40. Without --confirm any billed mode exits non-zero with no call. Refuse a billed mode when CLOUDFLARE_WORKER_URL is empty or the placeholder https://w.example. Stop immediately and keep partial rows on a 429, AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED or AI_DAILY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED. No retries, no replacement samples. Write the result JSON after every call. Output: mode, document_hash, planned_calls, max_calls, calls_made, stop_reason, rows.

TESTS FIRST in tests/test_opening_truck_probe4.py (hermetic; any real urlopen or socket reached fails the test; monkeypatch storygame.runtime.cloudflare.urlopen): arm A contains the reach bullet and Already done and no raw command line for both commands; arm B adds exactly one line; plan total 40 and --max-calls 39 rejected; billed modes without --confirm exit non-zero with zero calls; the placeholder URL is refused; a fake narrator drives a full --run to 40 rows with the expected round-robin; a fake 429 stops and keeps partial rows; --smoke makes exactly 2 calls. DONE WHEN the check passes. Report which helpers you imported and anything you could not do.
